scientific_integrity: Symbolic algebra for small paths is proved analytically; exact rational finite enumeration corroborates the five-vertex witness. Bibliographic equivalence risk remains. No external audit.
scientific_limitations: Single-source independent homogeneous bond percolation on paths, strictly positive fixed source probabilities and perfect eventual monitoring. No extension to temporal SIR or general graphs is proved.
title: A five-vertex threshold for reentrant epidemic-sentinel placement on a path
